title: apr serve --backend wgpu and apr finetune --backend wgpu still dequantize the whole model to F32 (the half of #2513 that run's fix did not reach)
evidence: origin/main@761d6247de, read 2026-09-27: crates/apr-cli/src/commands/serve/handlers.rs:889 dequantize_wgpu_weights called wgpu_adapter::dequant_model_weights (every tensor to F32) under cfg(feature="inference"), so a build WITHOUT the wgpu feature dequantized the whole model and then serve_wgpu_backend printed 'WGPU feature not enabled' and dropped it; with WGPU_Q4K the Q4_K projections were dequantized AND uploaded raw, the F32 copy skipped only at upload (upload_wgpu_q4k_weights). crates/apr-cli/src/commands/finetune.rs:766 collected the full F32 model before uploading it tensor by tensor, so the full F32 model plus a transposed copy of the current tensor were resident together. #2513 fixed only apr run (gguf_gpu_generate.rs try_wgpu_generate -> dequant_model_weights_except).
ask: fixed on branch fix/wgpu-serve-finetune-whole-dequant (no PR, cap full; fb folds after rc.1): wgpu_adapter::visit_model_weights_except streams tensors to a sink; finetune uploads each and drops it; serve dequantizes only in a wgpu build and skips the raw-Q4_K names under WGPU_Q4K. Tests: dequant_skip_2378::the_visitor_streams_rather_than_collecting_first (corrupt late tensor; earlier ones must already be handed over), the_visitor_hands_over_the_same_tensors_as_the_vec.

title: wgpu_adapter::raw_q4k_weights returns gate_proj as raw Q4_K bytes whatever its qtype
evidence: origin/main@761d6247de crates/aprender-serve/src/gpu/adapters/wgpu_adapter.rs raw_q4k_weights: o/up/down and separate q/k/v are filtered by tensor.qtype == GGUF_TYPE_Q4_K, gate_proj is pushed unconditionally. On a model whose ffn_gate is Q6_K/Q5_K (mixed-quant Q4_K_M files do this for some layers) the gate is uploaded to upload_q4k_weight as if it were Q4_K, and since #2513 it is also excluded from the F32 dequant, so no correct copy exists. apr run's multi-step parity gate (FALSIFY-CPU-GPU-006) would fall back to CPU; apr serve WGPU_Q4K has no parity gate. Not measured on a real mixed-quant file — read from source.
ask: filter gate_proj by qtype like the others; test with a fixture whose gate is Q6_K: it must be absent from raw_q4k_weights and present in dequant_model_weights_except(raw names). Not fixed on this branch (out of the scope 77 gave).
